interpretation.existing: An established local core/data/result contract exists. This does not claim that the Task 8 coordinator, Task 9 UI, reports, or release already expose it.
interpretation.new_binding: Required for 1.0 but the canonical project/result/UI binding is still pending. Proposed names are omitted when no stable contract exists.
interpretation.calculated_estimate: The 1.0 surface may show a traced engineering estimate with source, assumptions, uncertainty/limits, and diagnostics; it must not be presented as measured history.
interpretation.explicitly_excluded: Outside the approved 1.0 scope or dependent on a mapping not established from the available references; the UI/report must show the stated reason and no numeric placeholder.
interpretation.null_binding: null means unresolved; it must not be converted to zero or treated as a completed implementation.

field_keys.seen: Screenshot observation status: observed or unobserved.
field_keys.io: Field role: input, output, or control.
field_keys.canonical_input: Established canonical project/loading path when one exists; otherwise null.
field_keys.result_binding: Established core/result path when one exists; otherwise null. A non-null legacy result path does not imply Task 8/9 integration is complete.

scope_guardrails: All A-G requirements in docs/plimsoll-1.0/spec.md remain mandatory; this registry only covers the seven SPS reference pages.
Normal, deep/full and custom loading conditions use the shared project/loading contracts and one selected loading state.
Source, estimate, uncertainty, validity and diagnostics must survive coordinator, UI and exports.
This draft invents neither SPS algorithms nor accuracy comparisons and does not assess in-progress Task 4 or Task 7 implementation.
